label: Wild-catch fisher (general)
description: Catches wild seafood and sells at the dock. The original generic option.

label: Fish or shellfish farm (general)
description: Raises seafood and sells at the farm gate. The original generic option.

label: Inshore or day boat
description: A small boat that fishes close to shore and lands daily or weekly.

label: Offshore vessel (trawler, longliner)
description: A larger vessel landing bulk catch on longer trips.

label: Pot and trap fisher (crab, lobster)
description: Sets and hauls pots or traps; often holds catch live before sale.

label: Finfish farm (net-pen, pond, tank)
description: Raises finfish; feed is the largest cost.

label: Shellfish farm (oysters, clams, mussels, kelp)
description: Grows shellfish or seaweed; harvest timing is flexible within a window.

label: Fishing cooperative
description: Pools members' catch and sells it together.

label: Processor (fillet, freeze, smoke, can)
description: Buys at first-sale prices and sells processed product at wholesale.

label: Distributor or wholesaler
description: Buys from fishers and sells to restaurants and stores.

label: Fishmonger or seafood retailer
description: Buys wholesale and sells to shoppers at retail.

label: Restaurant or caterer buying seafood
description: Buys seafood for the kitchen and cares about price timing and quality.

label: Direct-to-consumer seller (market stall, subscription)
description: Sells straight to shoppers at retail prices.
